'''Airtight Base''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. It was [[Clabburn the Younger]]'s main base. Its entrance was guarded by two [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]].
